# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 26 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 26 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_026_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 1 — Believe in One God

**1** The first commandment: believe that God is one. He created everything and brought it all to completion. He made everything that exists out of nothing. He holds everything within himself, and yet nothing can hold him. **2** Believe in him. Fear him. And out of that fear, practice self-control. Do all this and you will strip wickedness right off yourself and clothe yourself in the full garment of righteousness. Live this way and you will live to God — that is the reward for keeping this commandment.

---

*PNEUMA note: This single commandment is a complete theology in miniature: monotheism, creation ex nihilo, divine transcendence and immanence. The Shepherd opens its moral instruction with "who is God?" — everything else follows from there.*
